IC1: History of three or more consecutively failed In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) cycles after embryo transfer.
IC2: Normal uterine cavity (as assessed by hysteroscopy [OR] or HSG).
IC3: Normal hormonal investigation: TSH, PRL, FBS.
IC4: Normal acquired/inherited thrombophilia profile: LAC, ACA IgG/IgM, Prot S, Antithrombin III, beta-2 glycoprotein, Factors V, II, MTHFR.
IC5: Normal semen analysis and mild [OR]/moderate male factor (Total motile sperm count  > 5 million/ml [OR] and/or normal WHO morphology >20%.
